metadata.title: SpaceMineralAtlas: crop-specific mineral responses to spaceflight, a unit-labelling defect in OSD-655, and a survey of mineral and dietary data availability across the NASA Life Sciences Data Archive
metadata.description:
Open-data reanalysis of the two NASA Veggie studies with archived ICP-OES elemental data (OSD-745 lettuce, OSD-655 Tokyo Bekana), Inspiration4 clinical chemistry (OSD-575), and a machine-readable survey of all 2,676 NASA Life Sciences Data Archive experiments annotated for mineral and dietary content and classified by accessibility.

Principal findings: (1) OSD-655 labels five elements as mg/g dry weight in both its data files and its archived data dictionary when the values are ug/g, a 1000-fold error; (2) the two Veggie crops do not share a flight ionome response, and apparent calcium and iron increases are dry-matter dilution artefacts that do not survive a centred log-ratio correction; (3) dietary mineral overload from Veggie produce is not achievable at plausible harvest scales.

All analysis code, harmonised data tables, the annotated LSDA catalog and the manuscript source are included. No value in this work is simulated; every input is retrieved from a public NASA API and checksummed.
